blocks.text: Historical event – North Korea signs a total agreement to denuclearize. More extreme weather, earthquakes, volcanic activity coming. Within a 30 day period there is a total lunar eclipse on Jul. 27th as well as 2 partial solar eclipses on Jul. 19th and Aug. 11th, 2018. Now a wonderful faith building writing from Brother Neal Frisby’s library.

“The world is rocking from one crisis to another one concerning nature and shock waves from the elements; floods, etc. Immorality is running full speed. Most of the world is naked, wretched and blind as judgment is echoing from heaven giving forth warning signs and portents of harbingers and omens of things to come!” When the Scripts said bad moon rising, even the media is backing it up in their news daily! The world is filled with anxiety and perplexities looking for a way out. “But thanks be unto God there is a way!” The former and latter rain is falling together. This is the good news, it is bringing forth marvelous wonders and real joy as He gathers His elect together for translation. We could write more on prophecy, but this is more important now. Below we are going to list some encouraging Scriptures to help all of God’s children!

Isa. 59:19, When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him. Luke 14:23, And the Lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled. Isa. 41:18, I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water. – This is symbolic of real restoration! It is now occurring!

Joel 2:28-30, And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit. And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, fire and pillars of smoke. “The last part reveals atomic and also supernatural signs of God! His spirit is now sweeping the Gentiles! And this outpouring will overlap into Rev. chap. 7 the true Israel side!” – Zech. 10:1, Ask ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain; so the Lord shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain; to every one grass in the field. – We’ve seen startling photographs of His marvelous shekinah clouds! – Hosea 10:12, Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek the Lord, till he come and rain righteousness upon you. – Praise Him! So are His true people opening up their hearts! Although there are false lights, there are God’s true lights symbolizing our restoration! – Ezek. 1:28 saw them and said, As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake. – We can take it as a sign to us. He saw them run and return in the heavens as a flash of lightning! – Also He is ready to put in the final sickle! James 5:7-8, Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain. Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.

We are in the midnight cry! Matt 25:6, 10, And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh, go ye out to meet him. And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage; and the door was shut. – Rev. 10:3, And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices. The Thunders have to do with time, a message and other things! It also has to do with this Scripture. St. John 11:25, Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live. St. John 15:7, If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you. – Those who have salvation and eternal life it’s worth more than the whole world and universe, and it’s yours by faith in Jesus’ promises! – III John 1:2, Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth. This Scripture shows us 3 marvelous blessings! – He reigns with His people, time is short. “Faith is simply believing what you have already got! As you stand steadfast it will manifest! Jesus said it is finished! By His blood and resurrection we are saved, by His stripes we are healed. It’s a finished work. – Believe!” – End quote.

This month I am releasing “The 7th Trumpet – 3rd Woe!” – Part 4 book and also a DVD “Impact!” – This month your help is vital. Remember our representative who is in Africa for a long summer crusade. We sent many CD’s and books. Your support will help in many ways to get the gospel out. I sincerely appreciate it. May Jesus guide you with His wisdom and prosper you daily. I will be remembering you in prayer.
